title: Point-contact spectroscopy of two-band superconductor MgB2
abstract: The progress in investigation of two-band superconductor MgB$_2$ by the point-contact spectroscopy (PCS) is given. Results of study of superconducting gap temperature and magnetic field dependence for two-dimensional $σ$ and three-dimensional $π$ band and electron-phonon-interaction spectral function are presented. Correlation between the gap value and the intensity of the high T$_c$ driving force -- $E_{2g}$ boron vibration mode, is provided. PCS data on some nonsuperconducting transition metal diborides are surveyed for comparison.
